domainRules.statement: Every state-changing command is evaluated against aggregate id, expected version, current state, actor and capabilities, policy version, effective-current evidence, blocking obligations, invariants, effect implications, idempotency key, time and correlation ids.
A transition result is exactly one of Accepted | Rejected | Deferred | Conflict | UnknownExternalEffect.
Legal capabilities are derived from current state by Tier 2; no caller infers allowed mutations.
A command with a stale expected version yields Conflict; no last-writer-wins for state transitions.
Testable requires a falsifiable proposition and a defined population/market scope.
Supported requires both a supporting-evidence review and a counter-evidence review; confidence never substitutes for evidence references.
Rejected and reopened hypotheses preserve prior lifecycle, evidence and rationale.
A problem is represented independently of any Echelon solution.
Corroborated requires explicit affected actor and consequence; CommerciallyRelevant requires evidence beyond social attention; workaround is Unknown or recorded, never assumed absent.
Original source reference is immutable; interpretation is not stored as raw observation; capture time and observed time are distinct types.
Stale evidence cannot satisfy a current-evidence requirement.
Agent inference is never labelled as source evidence; repetition never strengthens evidence; contradictions are retained.
Derived evidence closure is acyclic and every referenced input exists.
Negative knowledge is scoped (target, scope, method, time, coverage); absence is supported only by Complete coverage for the same scope.
Organization and contact merges are reversible and preserve references and provenance.
CommunicationEligibility is the single source of truth for contactability; Contact and Organization lifecycles do not encode it.
A negative restriction at any scope overrides every positive permission; an organization DoNotEngage blocks all affiliated contacts; evaluated at send time.
A restriction stays active until lifted by an explicit authorized transition recording actor, rationale and time; agents cannot lift; lifting retains history.
Qualify requires the policy-selected evidence dimensions; missing information yields obligations (Deferred), never fabricated values.
Qualification dimensions remain individually inspectable with representable uncertainty; no opaque single score.
ConvertToOpportunity is legal only from Qualified and creates an Opportunity in a defined initial state.
Won requires a defined commercial outcome; Proposal requires problem/value context and proposal capability; elapsed time alone never advances stage.
Dormant is distinct from Lost; Lost retains reason, evidence and alternative when known; reopening preserves history.
Activate requires objective, audience, hypothesis, success/failure criteria, stop rules, budget policy, channel policy and required approval.
A paused campaign blocks new outbound effects, including previously queued ones unless policy explicitly permits in-flight effects.
Communication eligibility is checked at send time; DoNotContact/Unsubscribed dominates campaign intent and cannot be overridden by agents.
Send requires Approved content + eligibility + capability + policy + idempotency key; content approval is distinct from send eligibility.
Duplicate target/provider identity cannot create duplicate sends.
Unknown outcome is first-class, creates a reconciliation obligation and forbids automatic retry or compensation before reconciliation.
Provider success without local persistence becomes reconciliation work; local persistence or Git commit success never implies provider success.
Inbox processing is idempotent; provider redelivery never duplicates domain effects.
Approval scope names exact action, material and content hash/version; editing approved material invalidates or narrows the approval.
Waive requires actor capability and rationale; open blocking obligations prevent the transitions they block.
Running requires hypothesis and expected signal; interpretation criteria precede results where practical; results are immutable.
A signal never directly creates a Lead, Opportunity or market conclusion.
Publishing verifies every governed claim is Approved and effective-current.
Agent authority is capability-scoped and revocable; agents request transitions and never call providers directly.
Projections are never canonical write models; replay never repeats external effects.
No state machine may use an Unknown value to bypass a required invariant; Unknown yields an explicit legal path or obligation.
